summary: Bans gender-affirming medical care for minors (the SAFE Act, in force since 28 August 2023 after a judge declined to block it) and restricts access to such treatment for people in prisons, jails and correctional centres, with providers facing licence revocation; no adult facility ban recorded. Slightly below the national score 0.36.

sources.summary: PBS NewsHour report (29 August 2023, St Louis): a judge denied a preliminary injunction against Missouri's ban on gender-affirming medical care for minors, so the Save Adolescents from Experimentation (SAFE) Act took effect 28 August 2023 — prohibiting hormones/puberty blockers for under-18s (unless already in treatment) and all transition-related surgeries for minors; the law also bars MO HealthNet Medicaid coverage, restricts treatment access in prisons, jails and correctional centres, exposes violating providers to licence revocation, and sunsets in 2027 after a Republican–Democrat concession; plaintiffs (ACLU of Missouri, Lambda Legal and others) continue toward trial on the merits.

localsOnly: The minors-care ban, the Medicaid (MO HealthNet) coverage exclusion and the 2027 sunset bind residents and their providers; a visitor's exposure is the institutional posture they signal, not these mechanisms.
